answer: The fine for not wearing a helmet is ₹1,000, with possible driving licence disqualification for 3 months (Motor Vehicles Amendment Act, 2019, Section 129/194D).
The fine for drunk driving is ₹10,000, with possible imprisonment up to 6 months for a first offence (Motor Vehicles Amendment Act, 2019, Section 185).
The fine for overspeeding is ₹1,000 to ₹2,000 for a first offence (Motor Vehicles Amendment Act, 2019, Section 112/183).
The fine for using a mobile phone while driving is ₹5,000 (Motor Vehicles Amendment Act, 2019, Section 184).
